_comment: Shared metrics definitions for NVMe PCI libsensors targets with composite and per-sensor temperatures

Composite.description: Composite NVMe drive temperature reported by the controller sensor

low.description: Configured low composite temperature threshold for the NVMe drive

high.description: Configured high composite temperature threshold for the NVMe drive

critical.description: Configured critical composite temperature threshold for the NVMe drive

alarm.description: Composite thermal alarm status reported by the NVMe drive

Sensor_1.description: Additional NVMe drive temperature reported by sensor 1

Sensor_2.description: Additional NVMe drive temperature reported by sensor 2

Sensor_3.description: Additional NVMe drive temperature reported by sensor 3
